text: @ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui 是面向 DSH Web 对话的可交互界面插件。它注册生成式界面和只读表格工具，并把保存的界面呈现在聊天中。用户可制作带控件的说明卡、计算器和图表，也可按地点生成地图行程、请求有署名的图片，或用结构化文字展示数据表。适合希望在对话里把解释、数据和交互控件组合成可回放视觉内容的用户。使用基础功能无需额外账号；选择高德地图提供者时需配置 DSH_AMAP_KEY，地图瓦片和所请求图片会从对应外部服务获取。

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui adds interactive visuals to DSH Web chats: replayable explanation cards, calculators, charts and read-only tables. Map tools build street itineraries from place names and can add credited images. Basic use needs no account; the AMap provider requires DSH_AMAP_KEY.
想让 DSH 在聊天里生成可以编辑的图表和交互说明卡。
需要把地点和行程做成带街道信息的地图展示。
I want DSH to turn structured information into a readable table inside the conversation.
@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui 的功能「交互式视觉卡片」：在对话中生成说明、图表或计算器界面，可包含 HTML、CSS、控件和脚本，并作为保存的文档交给客户端呈现。
@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui 的功能「地图行程」：地图工具可根据地点名称解析位置并生成街道地图；配置高德提供者时使用高德查询，也可请求地点图片并附带署名。

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 为什么使用它：有些问题，需要亲手调节参数、比较选项，或看一遍过程。

DSH Intelligent UI 为这些问题提供交互式呈现。你描述目标，当前 DSH 模型调用工具生成界面，插件负责校验、显示和保存。界面中的按钮还可以携带当前参数，经过你的确认后，将问题送回原会话继续讨论。

| 想做什么 | 可以生成什么 | 试着这样说 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 搞懂一个原理 | 带参数、动画与公式的演示 | “用可调摆长的单摆解释周期。” |
| 比较几种选择 | 对比卡片、评分或交互计算器 | “做一个三种方案的成本比较器。” |
| 展示一组数据 | 表格、柱状图、饼图、折线图 | “把这些数值画成图，注明单位和来源。” |
| 介绍地点或路线 | 地图、地点卡片、照片和行程播放 | “在地图上介绍某地的三个景点。” |
| 做一个小工具 | 表单控件、计算器、DOM/SVG/Canvas 应用 | “生成一个可以直接操作的单位换算器。” |
| 收集选择、展示进度 | 会议时间选择、只读工作流 | “让我从这三个会议时间中选择一个。” |

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 核心能力：- **在聊天里直接操作**：支持 HTML、CSS、JavaScript，以及 DOM、SVG、Canvas。生成过程中先显示静态预览，工具成功后再启用交互。
- **结果持续显示**：使用独立的聊天结果节点，保留工具返回的界面；支持历史重放、重置和单文件 HTML 导出。
- **界面跟随宿主**：适配 DSH 浅色/深色、字号和字体，内容自动测高，并显示可捕获的脚本运行错误。
- **常用组件开箱可用**：六种模板、结构化文本表格、内置 Chart.js 4.5.1 和 Leaflet 1.9.4，无需生成代码加载 CDN。
- **高德地图接入**：支持高德地点搜索与官方静态底图，保留地点标记、选点、缩放、平移和行程播放；Key 只在 Host 侧使用。
- **资源可追溯**：保留原有 OpenFreeMap 与百科/Commons 图片模式，展示地点来源和图片署名；个别地点无法定位时明确提示，其余已确认地点继续显示。
- **交互回到原会话**：追问经用户确认后提交，区分“等待确认”“已入队”和模型的运行、完成、失败或取消状态。
- **也能独立作为 MCP 使用**：复用文档校验、模板和 HTML 装配；适合需要自行接入渲染容器的客户端。

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 使用预构建包安装：已有 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 和正在使用的 Web profile 时，可以直接安装 Release 中的预构建包，无需克隆源码或本地编译：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/NingTiAn-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui/releases/download/v1.2.1/dsh-intelligent-ui.tgz --ignore-scripts
```

将 `web` 替换为实际 profile 名称。安装后按宿主提示刷新或重启；模型服务使用该 profile 自己的配置。下方是源码开发和独立实例的启动方式。

git clone https://github.com/NingTiAn-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui.git
cd dsh-intelligent-ui
npm ci
npm run build

构建使用锁文件中的 rc.2 SDK，不再依赖 alpha.4 源码链接。`lib/`、`dist/` 和预览页面都是生成产物；从 Git 获取源码后需要先构建。

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 2. 离线预览：```sh
npm run preview
```

在无图形环境中只生成页面并打印位置：

```sh

```

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 如何验证主线：1. **模型调用工具**：检查轨迹；默认先选择展示形式，再调用 UI、表格或专项工具。
2. **显示交互界面**：确认出现卡片并能操作，而不只是模型声称“已生成”。
3. **保存与重放**：等待本轮结束，刷新并重新打开同一会话，确认保存的界面仍可渲染。
4. **追问回到会话**：在界面内发起追问，在宿主确认后，检查当前会话收到消息及模型回复。

保存的是界面文档和资源，**不保证保留滑块位置、游戏分数等临时运行状态**。重置或重新挂载会重新运行界面。导出的 HTML 可独立交互，但不能直接向 DSH 发送追问。

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 工具清单：| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `select_intelligent_ui_presentation` | 为当前用户消息选择 `text`、`table`、`ui` 或 `mixed`；由当前模型决定，无独立分类服务 |
| `render_intelligent_ui` | 生成通用交互界面，分别提供 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript |
| `get_intelligent_ui_template` | 获取 `calculator`、`comparison`、`flowchart`、`chart_line`、`chart_bar`、`chart_pie` 模板 |
| `render_intelligent_table` | 展示只读文本表格，最多 12 列、200 行 |
| `render_intelligent_chart` | 通过结构化参数生成柱状图或饼图，附单位、来源与数据表 |
| `render_intelligent_map` | 按配置使用高德底图快照或原有 OpenFreeMap 模式，展示地点、卡片和行程播放 |
| `lookup_intelligent_ui_places` | 高德模式按名称与城市查询 POI，返回 GCJ-02 坐标；原有模式查询百科坐标，均保留来源 |
| `search_intelligent_ui_images` | 搜索 Commons 图片文件名与署名，最多返回 4 项 |
| `plan_intelligent_ui` | 展示可视化方案、技术选择和关键元素 |
| `render_intelligent_workflow` | 展示只读任务状态快照，不执行或推进任务 |
| `choose_intelligent_meeting_time` | 通过 DSH 人工问答选择会议时间，不创建预约 |

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 工具清单：展示路由是同一个会话模型的一次工具选择。需要 UI 时，先完成选择，再在后续模型步骤调用渲染工具；不需要可视化的问题可以直接用文字回答。

注册实现：[Host 入口](src/index.ts) · [专项工具](src/host/features.ts) · [展示路由](src/host/routing.ts)。

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 工作原理：```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[用户描述需求] --> B[当前 DSH 模型]
    B --> C[选择展示形式并调用工具]
    C --> D[Host 校验并保存文档及资源]

Host 管理工具、资源获取和文档校验；Client 管理聊天节点、iframe、主题和消息桥接；DSH 继续管理模型、会话、队列与人工问答。界面资源保存在工具结果 metadata 中，重放时无需重新让模型生成整份界面。

生成代码在独立来源、`sandbox="allow-scripts"` 的 iframe 内运行。流式阶段不执行生成脚本；成功后启用脚本。追问和外链经受限桥接交给宿主确认。

工具失败时，卡片会显示可用的具体错误文本，历史重放也保留该错误；失败或中断的预览不会启用脚本。

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 高德地图：高德模式使用 **Web服务 Key**：Host 调用地点搜索、坐标转换和官方静态地图接口，Leaflet 负责聊天卡片中的显示和交互。不需要申请 Web端（JS API）Key；当前实现也不是高德 JS 动态瓦片地图。

1. 在高德控制台为应用申请 **Web服务** Key。
2. 在插件根目录创建 `.env`，写入 `DSH_AMAP_KEY=你的高德Web服务Key`。默认自动读取该文件，与 DSH 的启动目录无关；修改后重启 DSH。也可用 `amapEnvFile` 指定其他 `.env` 路径。
3. 复制 [amap.example.yml](preview/amap.example.yml) 为 `preview/amap.local.yml`，填入真实文件路径：

```yaml
- id: intelligent-ui
  config:
    mapProvider: amap
    # amapEnvFile: 'D:/keys/.env' # Optional; defaults to the plugin root .env

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 高德地图：4. 用覆盖层启动独立 Web profile：

```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run-dsh.ps1 -ImageNetworkPatch preview/amap.local.yml
```

已有客户端应将相同配置应用到其实际使用的 profile，然后完全退出并重启。不要通过 CLI 直接启动保留的 `desktop` profile，它由 Electron 客户端管理。

Key 不进入生成界面、工具结果或导出的 HTML；也不要将密钥文件提交 Git。`preview/amap.local.yml` 已被忽略，但放在其他位置的密钥文件需要自行排除。

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 高德地图：| 行为 | 高德模式 | 原有模式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 配置 | `mapProvider: amap`，需要 Web服务 Key | `mapProvider: openfreemap`，默认值 |
| 地点查询 | 按名称与城市搜索高德 POI，显示实际匹配名称与来源 | 精确百科条目与中英文关联回退 |
| 底图 | 高德官方固定区域图片快照 | 下载并保存有界街道矢量数据 |
| 坐标 | 使用 GCJ-02；显式 WGS84 输入通过官方接口转换 | 使用 WGS84 |
| 自动照片 | 不自动请求海外百科照片；显式图片请求仍走独立管线 | 可自动查询百科/Commons 配图，最多四张 |
| 重放 | 重用保存的底图图片与文档 | 重用保存的几何与文档 |
@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 高德地图：调用地图工具时建议提供 `city`。显式坐标输入的 `coordinateSystem` 默认为 `wgs84`；若已有高德坐标，应声明 `gcj02`，避免重复转换。请求有节流和有限重试，权限、配额和网络错误仍会明确报告。未配置高德的 profile 不会自动切换，旧历史文档也不会被改写。

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 通用参数：通过 DSH profile 的插件配置或额外 patch 覆盖参数。仓库的 [默认 patch](cordis.patch.yml) 定义插件入口；下面的覆盖层可配合启动脚本 `-ImageNetworkPatch` 使用，该参数实际上接收通用的额外 patch 文件。

```yaml
- id: intelligent-ui
  config:
    maxDocumentChars: 200000
    minHeight: 180

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 通用参数：| 参数 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `maxDocumentChars` | HTML、CSS、JavaScript 总字符上限，可设为 1000～200000 |
| `minHeight` / `maxHeight` | 初始高度边界，均在 180～900 px 内，最小值不能大于最大值 |
| `routing` | `model` 为默认展示路由；`off` 关闭路由限制 |

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · Why use it?：Some questions need a short explanation. Others become easier to understand when you can adjust a parameter, compare options, or watch a process unfold.

DSH Intelligent UI handles those interactive presentations. Your current DSH model calls tools to create a document; the plugin validates, renders and saves it. Buttons can include current values in a follow-up question and, after your confirmation, send it back to the original conversation.

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · Why use it?：**No orders, sales data or business database is required.** Formulas, user-provided data, clearly labelled synthetic data, places and educational explanations are all valid inputs. Real data must still come from your existing sources or DSH tools.

| --- | --- | --- |
| Understand a principle | Parameters, animation and formulas | “Explain a pendulum with an adjustable length.” |
| Compare options | Comparison cards or an interactive calculator | “Build a cost calculator for these three plans.” |
| Explore data | Tables, bar/pie charts and line charts | “Chart these values with units and sources.” |
| Introduce places | Maps, photos, place cards and itinerary playback | “Introduce three Beijing landmarks on a map.” |
| Build a small utility | DOM, SVG or Canvas applications | “Create an interactive unit converter.” |
| Gather choices or show progress | Meeting-time selection and workflow snapshots | “Let me select one of these three meeting times.” |

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · Highlights：- **Interact directly in chat.** Separate HTML, CSS and JavaScript support DOM, SVG and Canvas. Static previews appear during generation; scripts activate after successful tool completion.
- **Keep the result.** Dedicated conversation nodes retain tool results for history replay, reset and single-file HTML export.
- **Follow the host appearance.** DSH theme, font and text-size integration, automatic height, and feedback for browser-reported runtime errors.
- **Start with useful components.** Six templates, structured text tables, bundled Chart.js 4.5.1 and Leaflet 1.9.4. Generated code does not need a CDN.
- **Use AMap for domestic maps.** The Host supports AMap POI search and official static basemaps, with markers, selection, pan/zoom and itinerary playback. Keys stay on the Host.
- **Retain resource provenance.** The original OpenFreeMap and Wikipedia/Commons pipeline remains available. Unresolved places are listed explicitly while confirmed stops remain visible.
- **Continue the conversation.** Confirm follow-ups before submission. Queue receipts are separate from model running, completion, failure and cancellation states.

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · Check the complete flow：1. **Tool call:** inspect the trajectory. With default routing, the model selects a presentation before calling the rendering tools.
2. **Interaction:** confirm a usable card appears, rather than trusting a textual “generated” claim.
3. **Save and replay:** wait for the turn to finish, refresh, and reopen the same conversation. Confirm the saved document renders again.
4. **Follow-up:** request an explanation from the card, confirm it in the host, and check the message and model response in the original conversation.

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · Check the complete flow：The saved artifact is a document and its resources. **Transient slider positions, game scores and similar runtime state are not guaranteed to persist.** Reset or remount runs the interface again. Exported HTML can remain interactive, but cannot submit live DSH follow-ups on its own.

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · Tools：Presentation routing is a tool decision by the same conversation model. Complete the selection first, then call rendering tools in a subsequent model step. Questions that do not benefit from a visual can be answered directly in text.

Implementation: [Host entry](src/index.ts) · [Specialized tools](src/host/features.ts) · [Presentation routing](src/host/routing.ts).

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · How it works：```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[User request] --> B[Current DSH model]
    B --> C[Presentation selection and tool call]
    C --> D[Host validates and saves document and resources]

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · How it works：The Host owns tools, resource preparation and document validation. The Client owns conversation nodes, the iframe, theme integration and message bridging. DSH continues to own models, sessions, queues and human questions. Tool-result metadata carries the document, so history replay does not require the model to regenerate the entire interface.

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · How it works：Generated code runs inside an opaque-origin iframe with `sandbox="allow-scripts"`. Scripts remain inactive during streaming and activate after tool success. Follow-ups and external links use a restricted bridge with host confirmation.

Failed cards show available tool-error text, including after history replay. Failed or interrupted previews keep scripts inactive.

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · FAQ：
I have rc.2 installed. Why are the tools missing? A matching host version is only a prerequisite. Install and enable the built plugin in the profile used by the current conversation. An isolated test profile and the default Desktop profile can have different plugins. Check the actual `DSH_HOME`, profile and loading logs.
The model outputs code or says “generated,” but no card appears.

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · FAQ：Look for a successful rendering tool call in the trajectory. Default routing requires `select_intelligent_ui_presentation` with `ui`, then a rendering call in the next model step. If no tool was called, check plugin loading, model tool support and whether the prompt clearly requests an interactive interface.
The interface flashes and disappears, or is missing after refresh.

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · FAQ：The current implementation retains results in dedicated conversation nodes. Confirm the current build is loaded, check whether the tool succeeded, inspect saved document metadata, and look for browser loading or runtime errors. Replay restores the document, not all transient interaction state.
A follow-up is queued. Has the model finished?

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · FAQ：No. The `sendPrompt()` Promise reports confirmation and queue acceptance. Independent run-status events track the model. Only `completed` for the matching request means that turn finished; read its response in the DSH conversation.
Do maps or photos require another API key?

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · FAQ：AMap requires a Web-service key. The original OpenFreeMap/Wikipedia pipeline does not require a separate map key, but initial retrieval needs network access. AMap does not automatically fetch encyclopedia photos; explicit image requests use the independent image pipeline. Your model provider still needs its own configuration. Documents allow up to four photos. See the [AMap example](preview/amap.example.yml) and the [legacy resource proxy example](preview/images-network.example.yml).

</details>

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · FAQ：
Why does npm test ask for DSH source? Normal builds use npm SDK packages, but the suite also tests the real internal Conversation assembler. Prepare the official `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2` source tag as described in the [development notes](docs/development.md). Building the entire host is unnecessary.

@ningtian-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui README · Runtime limits：- Generated scripts cannot directly manipulate the host DOM, load arbitrary remote scripts or make arbitrary network requests. Controlled Host capabilities handle external resources.
- Saved documents and resources can replay; initial photo/street preparation still needs networking. Legacy NASA/USGS modes may use fixed-origin remote tiles.
- AMap is a fixed-region basemap snapshot: zooming adds no new detail. Itinerary connections are ordered straight segments, not road-route planning.
- Structured tables are read-only text tables without built-in sorting, filtering or pagination. Use the general UI tool for those interactions.
- Meeting choices do not create calendar bookings. Workflow snapshots do not execute tasks. No business database is bundled.
- Runtime feedback does not recover from infinite loops or browser crashes. Check generated games, calculations and scientific simulations for correctness.

| `npm run check` | Strict Host, Client and MCP TypeScript checks |
| `npm test` | Unit, integration and browser tests; internal projection checks require matching source |
| `npm run verify:mcp` | Verify stdio handshake, resources, prompts and tools with an actual MCP client |
| `npm run audit:release` | Check publication candidates for local outputs, recognized secrets and personal paths |

Default regressions use controlled fixtures rather than a live model. Live-model end-to-end behavior and network resources need separate checks.
